title: Use one clean carry for the complete selected P104 scalar layer
body:
The complete selected PR6030 scalar layer now uses one clean carry bit, with exclusive temporary source writes and paired real/imaginary target access. Every ADD restores its source; every scalar circuit restores the carry before the next event. SCALE needs no extra dirty component bank.

At W=64 per complex component pair, the full bill is 4,959,280 Toffolis, 10,267,972 CNOTs and 7,936 charged bit-reset requests. Relative to PR6506's emitted read-only-source implementation, this removes 3,818,524 unweighted logical gates and reduces clean carry from 63 bits to one. CNOTs increase; no all-tariff or runtime advantage is asserted. Multiply gate/reset counts by payload dimension D. Native, reset, routing, conversion and clean backing remain separate costs.

Existing PR3152 ADD and PR3159 paired SCALE mechanisms retain credit. This integration also uses direct rotations and removes known zero low bits from paired negation. The source alignment is rebuilt for all 19,288 scalar events. Two complete 22,803-event Gaussian traces match rational execution, including 37,715 circuit calls each. Seven complete width bills, 98,662 exhaustive small truth columns and literal inverses, serialized width-64 circuits, source/carry returns and three semantic controls pass.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal/optimized replay, committed bytes/modes, official export and read-only Git-free/empty-PATH normal/optimized replay pass at `39b87aa272de863f454df3e7c8d7bbec4fa4efa3`. Hosted CI is pending. ORIGINS.json binds the byte-exact PR6506 comparator; no pending source checkout is needed. All other live inputs come from the immediate main parent. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-one-carry-scalar-layer`.

The supported emitted widths are 26..256. Whole-word fixtures use native-grid stubs, and the strict numerical range premise remains PR6499's declared interface. Physical source/paired access, native children, actual reset, all-size compiler and outer admission remain open. No new kappa, complete multiplier or selected-frontier change.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19364012). Main, revision 8 and current overlap were refreshed. Credit Nick Petalas/PR3081/3152/3159, [Cuccaro-Draper-Kutin-Moulton](https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/0410184), PR6506/6499, DreamingOfClouds/PR6030 and the retained scalar/native/compiler lineage. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
